title: Medical Records Requests Delivery Options and Record Formats Card
content:
Every Medical Records Requests type offers its own delivery methods and produces its own record format. The delivery methods are drawn from portal, email, mail, fax, pickup and disc by mail.

## Delivery

| Request type | Delivery methods offered | Unencrypted email after the patient acknowledges the risk | Pickup hold (calendar days) | Fax page limit (pages) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | Portal | No | 0 | 0 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | Portal, email | Yes | 0 | 0 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Mail, pickup | No | 30 | 0 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | Fax, portal | No | 0 | 150 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | Mail, fax, email | No | 0 | 50 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Mail, pickup | No | 30 | 0 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | Disc by mail, pickup | No | 30 | 0 |

The pickup hold is the number of calendar days records ready for pickup are held before being mailed or destroyed. The fax page limit is the largest number of pages delivered by fax; larger releases go by mail or portal.

**Fax limit on both sides (hypothetical page counts).** A Provider-to-Provider Transfer of 150 pages is within its limit of 150 and may be faxed; one of 151 pages is larger than the limit and is not faxed. A Third-Party Authorized Release of 50 pages may be faxed; one of 51 pages is not.

## Content and format produced

| Request type | Record format | Diagnostic images included (not only reports) | Signed custodian affidavit accompanies the records | Release entered in the disclosure log | Largest span of dates of service per request (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | PDF | No | No | No | 10 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | C-CDA XML | No | No | No | 10 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Paper | No | No | No | 10 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | C-CDA XML | Yes | No | Yes | 10 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | PDF | No | No | Yes | 10 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Certified paper | No | Yes | Yes | 10 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | DICOM disc | Yes | No | No | 5 |

## Reading the card

- Email is offered on the Patient Electronic Copy Request and the Third-Party Authorized Release; only the Patient Electronic Copy Request allows unencrypted email.
- Fax is offered only on the Provider-to-Provider Transfer and the Third-Party Authorized Release, the two types with a fax page limit above 0.
- Diagnostic images, and not only reports, are included on the Provider-to-Provider Transfer and the Imaging Disc Copy Request.
- The Imaging Disc Copy Request covers at most 5 years of dates of service per request; every other type covers at most 10.
